column4: MONDAY, JUNE 10, 2019 CERTIORARI -- SUMMARY DISPOSITIONS 18-9001 JOHNSON, TERRY V. LOUISIANA The motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and the petition for a writ of certiorari are granted. The judgment is vacated, and the case is remanded to the Court of Appeal of Louisiana, Fifth Circuit, for further consideration in light of Flowers v. Mississippi, 588 U. S. ___ (2019).
